h1: Laser Marks That Last the Life of the Tool
lead: We laser engrave logos and lettering on manual bar tools for branded barware and gift projects. Send your logo or idea. Our factory team creates the design and visual mockup free of charge, then produces your marked sample.
html:
Questions Before You Order

What are your payment terms?

We require a 30% deposit. The remaining 70% must be paid in full before shipment.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept T/T (bank transfer), Western Union and Alipay.

Which currencies can I pay in?

We accept USD, CNY, EUR and GBP. Other currencies can also be arranged for your order.

Which trade terms do you offer?

We offer EXW (Ex Works), FOB Shenzhen, C&F and DDP. The trade term is agreed with you for each order.

Does laser engraving use the same minimums as a one-, two- or three-color printed logo?

No. The 250, 1,000 and 2,000-piece thresholds are logo-printing color minimums. Laser projects use the selected manual tool and its product order quantity.

What do you need to position a logo on a manual bar tool?

Send the tool reference, logo or text and the intended marking location. We prepare the design layout and a product mockup for that selected tool.

Compare the Relevant Products and Service

Email Us for Free Design and a Project Quote
